text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer organized response with first/next/finally and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clearer overall structure with distinct body paragraphs and signposted progression."},{"evidence":"topic sentence then supporting example in each paragraph","quality":"development","description":"It develops its position with repeated explanation and examples rather than mainly stating ideas."},{"evidence":"academic prompt language like 'In my opinion' and 'For example'","quality":"register control","description":"The essay more consistently uses formal argumentative-writing language appropriate to the task."},{"evidence":"more sustained attempt at explaining reasons","quality":"elaboration","description":"It spends more effort expanding on claims and connecting them to the main argument."},{"evidence":"fewer interruptions from sentence-by-sentence idea shifts","quality":"coherence","description":"Its ideas generally stay on one line of argument with less abrupt drift than the other essay."}]}
